title: Add candidate prefilter before code-search vector scoring
description: Code-search retrieval currently loads all indexed chunks and performs full in-memory vector scoring/sort per uncached query. Introduce a high-ROI candidate-reduction stage before vector scoring (lexical prefilter or equivalent), then benchmark candidate counts, latency, and ranking impact. Keep behavior feature-flagged and reversible until benchmark evidence is stable.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from the 2026-05-28 deep audit item about brute-force in-memory code-search vector retrieval. Scope should start with a reversible candidate prefilter and benchmark harness expansion before committing to ANN or storage migration.
